name: Plavi okean

designTokens.shapeLanguage: rounded shells, inset water channels and raised clay tiles
designTokens.shadowLanguage: soft top-left highlights with cool blue raised and inset shadows

rules: Keep every game layout and interaction shared with the base game.
Keep all Plavi okean styling isolated under body.winter-theme.
Keep the center of the background calm enough for menus and score tables.
Use dark navy text on pale ocean surfaces and white text only on deep-blue controls.
Preserve the existing board dimensions, grid geometry and responsive breakpoints.
Use the existing winter theme ID so saved profiles remain compatible.
